about: Acceptance gates of the head pose against the Windows Stream Engine's (the DLL's), per session: bounds on the metrics of `tobii5-init-replay compare-dll sessionN.bin sessionN.jsonl --head --gates tools/headpose/gates.json`, which replays the session's IR images through the daemon's head pose (HeadStep, HeadParams::FITTED) and pairs each image with the DLL's pose of it. A gate by compare-dll is checked there, and fails the run when it fails. A gate by python bounds the lag or the rest jitter of the filters, which are measured in Python from the run's --csv rows against the head-pose study's stateless reference; compare-dll lists it unchecked. Images: ALL are those on which the DLL's pose and ours are both valid; COMB those of ALL where the DLL's |yaw| is above 15 deg and its |pitch| above 8 deg or its |roll| above 10 deg. Errors: of each yxz angle, |wrap(ours - DLL)|, deg; geodesic, the angle of R_ours^T R_DLL with R = Ry(y) Rx(x) Rz(z), deg; of the position, |ours - DLL| along each axis of the display frame, mm. A median or percentile interpolates linearly between ranks, as NumPy's default does.
status: provisional: the head-pose study's gates (acceptance_gates.out, 2026-09-29), its Python pipeline's leave-one-session-out values with headroom for the port to Rust, until the commit that fits the constants again on the Rust tracker sets them from the Rust baseline

gates.name: coverage of DLL-valid frames (%)
gates.about: of the images the DLL's pose is valid on, the share ours is valid on too, %

gates.name: validity agreement (%)
gates.about: of the images the DLL reported a pose for, valid or not, the share on which ours has the same validity, %

gates.name: DLL loss events detected
gates.about: the DLL's losses of the face (runs of images its pose is invalid on) that a run of our invalid poses overlaps; in s3 the 5-image loss at image 2659 is one the study's pipeline does not see either

gates.name: rotation median |e| pitch (deg)
gates.about: the median over ALL of |wrap(ours - DLL)| of the x angle (pitch), deg

gates.name: rotation median |e| yaw (deg)
gates.about: the median over ALL of |wrap(ours - DLL)| of the y angle (yaw), deg

gates.name: rotation median |e| roll (deg)
gates.about: the median over ALL of |wrap(ours - DLL)| of the z angle (roll), deg

gates.name: |median signed pitch error| (deg)
gates.about: the median over ALL of wrap(ours - DLL) of the x angle (pitch), deg, bounded in magnitude: a constant pitch offset, the mark of a wrong head-frame offset Q

gates.name: rotation geodesic p95 ALL (deg)
gates.about: the 95th percentile over ALL of the geodesic angle between the two rotations, deg

gates.name: COMB pitch p95 |e| (deg)
gates.about: the 95th percentile over COMB of |wrap(ours - DLL)| of the x angle (pitch), deg: combined turns, where reading the angles in another Euler order shows

gates.name: COMB geodesic p95 (deg)
gates.about: the 95th percentile over COMB of the geodesic angle between the two rotations, deg

gates.name: position median |e| x (mm)
gates.about: the median over ALL of |ours - DLL| along the display frame's x axis, mm

gates.name: position median |e| y (mm)
gates.about: the median over ALL of |ours - DLL| along the display frame's y axis, mm

gates.name: position median |e| z (mm)
gates.about: the median over ALL of |ours - DLL| along the display frame's z axis, mm

gates.name: position p95 |e| z (mm)
gates.about: the 95th percentile over ALL of |ours - DLL| along the display frame's z axis, mm

gates.name: max |lag ours - DLL| rotation (ms)
gates.about: the largest over the three angles of |lag(ours) - lag(DLL)|, ms; a lag is the coherence-weighted phase delay over 0.4-2.6 Hz (128-image Hann segments in steps of 32, linear detrend, coherence above 0.2) behind the study's stateless image-synchronous reference (three landmark-model passes on each image, mapped as the pipeline maps a fit, unfiltered), the same estimator for both

gates.name: max |lag ours - DLL| position (ms)
gates.about: the largest over the three axes of |lag(ours) - lag(DLL)| of the position, ms, the lag as for G15

gates.name: rest jitter ratio rotation, min..max
gates.about: each angle's jitter at rest, ours over the DLL's: the SD of the 2 Hz zero-phase high-pass residual pooled over the stillest 25 % of the 1 s windows (by the reference's speed); the smallest and the largest of the three ratios must lie within the range

gates.name: rest jitter ratio position, min..max
gates.about: the same ratios of the position's three axes
